name: Speed & Engine Warehouse

about:
Speed & Engine Warehouse traces its roots to 1920, when Car Parts Machine opened in downtown El Paso, Texas, offering precision engine machining and parts. The business later adopted the Speed & Engine Warehouse name and expanded to a second location in Tucson, Arizona, where its headquarters now reside. The company remains a family-operated enterprise serving the Southwest from both storefronts.

Today the firm operates as a distributor of aftermarket and OEM replacement parts, stocking engine kits and components for a wide range of passenger-car and industrial engines — from Detroit Diesel to Honda. Its two locations carry inventory across categories that include engines and components, chassis, brakes, suspension, steering, drivetrain, ignition, cooling, and safety equipment, representing hundreds of performance and replacement brands.

The customer base spans automotive repair shops, engine builders, racing teams, fleet operators, and DIY enthusiasts throughout the El Paso and Tucson regions and beyond. Industries served include automotive aftermarket, motorsports and performance, heavy-duty diesel, and general industrial engine maintenance.

The company was founded to provide local machine-shop expertise and quality engine parts, a mission that evolved into a broad parts-distribution model while retaining the original focus on engine-related products.
